All checks pass. Here's what was built:

**`index.html`** + **`styles.css`** + **`faq.js`** — 7 cat FAQ items with a polished dark theme.

### Key decisions
| Concern | Approach |
|---|---|
| **Semantics** | Each trigger is `<button type="button">` inside `<h2>`, giving screen readers the correct heading + button role |
| **Collapsed by default** | JS adds `hidden` at init (not hardcoded in HTML), so content stays visible in no-JS/reader-mode environments |

/* ── Reset & base ────────────────────────────────────────── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --bg:          #0f1117;
  --surface:     #1a1d27;
  --surface-hi:  #22263a;
  --border:      #2e3250;
  --border-hi:   #4a5080;
  --accent:      #7c8cf8;

  --text:        #e2e4f0;

body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;

  line-height: 1.65;
  min-height: 100vh;

  top: -100%;
  left: 1rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  text-decoration: none;
  z-index: 100;
}
.skip-link:focus { top: 1rem; }

/* ── Page layout ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
header {
  background: var(--surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem 2rem;
  text-align: center;
}

header h1 {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--text);
}

header p {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

main {
  max-width: 780px;
  margin: 0 auto;

<script>
(() => {
  // Collapse all panels on init so content stays visible in no-JS / reader mode
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-trigger').forEach((btn) => {
    const panel = btn.closest('h2').nextElementSibling;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    panel.hidden = true;

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!open));
      panel.hidden = open;
    });

    // Escape collapses the open panel and returns focus to the trigger
    btn.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        btn.closest('h2').nextElementSibling.hidden = true;
        btn.focus();
      }
    });
  });
})();
